title: Project context
description: Shared context every automation reads: which environment variables carry the connection details, the defaults that are not worth repeating per application, the resource naming contract, and where each automation keeps its own configuration.

organizationUrlEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the organization URL. The name is versioned; the value is not.

projectEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the team project name.

expectedOrganizationEnv.description: Optional. Name of the environment variable holding the organization this configuration belongs to. When it is declared and set, Get-AdoContext refuses to run if the organization URL resolves to a different organization. A host allowlist cannot catch that: every organization on dev.azure.com shares one permitted host, so a mistyped or tampered organization URL otherwise receives the token. The name is versioned; the value is not, because an organization name is itself sensitive.

environments.description: Environment suffixes used to derive per-environment resource names.

boardTemplateTeam.description: Existing Team whose backlog iteration is copied to a newly created Team. Without it a new Team's Board fails to open with TF400509.

defaultIterationMacro.description: Macro assigned as the default iteration of a new Team.

teamAdministratorMode.description: How the Team administrator is chosen. 'authenticatedUser' promotes the identity behind the Personal Access Token; 'none' leaves administration untouched.

configurationSentinel.description: The only value an automation is allowed to overwrite. Anything else already carries somebody's decision.

grantAccessToAllPipelines.description: Keep false. A connection any pipeline may use is a lateral movement path, and the pipelines that need it are known at provisioning time.

naming.description: Resource naming contract. Every name is derived from the application key and the environment, with no per-environment exceptions: an override is how two resources that should match stop matching.

automations.description: Path registry, so an entry point has a default for every file it reads and the caller only overrides what differs.
